title: Run Camp — personal mini-dashboard (Lucy's scratch)
content:
Purpose: quick personal tracker for small throughput/latency sweeps. Not official — scratch + numbers I want to remember.

--- RAW TABLE (CSV-style) ---
Date,Run,Model,Quant,Batch,Seq_med,Throughput_tok_s,p50_lat_ms,p95_lat_ms,cost_per_1k_tokens,notes
2025-01-06,rc-001,gpt-small-v1,fp16,8,128,4200,28,72,0.12,baseline on 1xA10; KV cache OFF; noisy tokens from system messages
2025-01-06,rc-002,gpt-small-v1,int8,8,128,6100,22,55,0.08,int8 micro-quant -> big throughput win, slight p95 tail
2025-01-07,rc-007,redwood-7b-q4,qs8,4,256,3400,35,120,0.06,seen KV cache help on repeated prefixes (~+70% throughput)
2025-02-12,rc-014,redwood-13b,fp16,2,512,900,110,430,0.40,large p95 spikes when seq>400; try pre-trim prompts
2026-02-20,rc-112,redwood-7b-q4,qs8,16,64,9800,18,44,0.05,burst mode; batching dominates cost reduction; watch tail after 8 concurrent

--- QUICK NOTES / TO-DO ---
- Pattern: int8 / qs8 gives best cost/throughput for short seq (<200). For long sequences, fp16 still smoother p95.
- KV cache experiments: need a reproducible test harness — current runs are ad-hoc. Add stable prompt prefix set.
- Action: schedule small canary day (1h) where I run rc-112 config across 3 machines and record p99+ infra logs (SRE trace).
- Question: is the cost-per-1k here including infra amortization? (These are purely token-unit estimates; update with internal cost model before sharing.)

--- MINI CHART DATA (for quick glance) ---
labels: ["int8 short", "fp16 short", "qs8 burst", "13b long"]
throughput: [6100,4200,9800,900]
p50: [22,28,18,110]
cost: [0.08,0.12,0.05,0.40]

--- QUICK INTERPRETATION (one-liners) ---
- Best cheap short-run config = qs8 or int8 + batch 8–16; keep seq <= 128 for best p95.
- For >400 seq, avoid aggressive quant unless you verify p95 with long prompts.
- KV caching looks promising for repeated-prefix workloads; need stable prefix set + cache warmup timings.

--- LOGGED COMMANDS / NOTES ---
- run script: ./bench/run_single.sh --model redwood-7b-q4 --quant qs8 --batch 16 --seq 64 --out rc-112.log
- quick grep: cat rc-112.log | jq .summary | grep tokens/s

--- UNRESOLVED ---
- Decide how to tag these runs in JIRA (INF-789 is a catch-all for now).
- Convert promising runs into a short memo for product: 1) expected cost delta 2) latency SLO impact 3) suggested default profile.

--- TRIVIA / META ---
- This doc intentionally minimal — meant to be transcribed into a nicer sheet once I lock the kv-cache experiment.
- If anyone sees a huge outlier in rc-014 (13b long) ping me — I might have had background job interference.

(Last quick edit: 2026-02-28 — cleaned a few header lines, kept it lean.)
